purpose: Reproducible geographic verification of the identified FRC roster for the Fort Wayne study area.
rebuild_note: New verification rebuilt on 2026-10-22. Earlier geographic artifacts were unavailable, so these are newly documented source inputs and a newly fixed downtown reference point, not recovered original calculations. The canonical 13 Indiana plus 4 nearby-border roster is retained.

scope.location_rule: Linked high-school campus or community-host reference point; Matthews uses a clearly labeled town representative point because a physical team address was not confirmed.
scope.exhaustiveness_note: This file verifies the identified roster and named exclusions. It is not a census of every FIRST program, a verified inventory of all team workshops, or proof that no unlisted community team exists.

limitations: All distances refer to the specified point-to-point convention; they are not road mileage, travel time, city-boundary distance, or proof of each team's actual workshop location.
Census address geocoding is approximate street-range interpolation. Extra coordinate decimals are retained for reproducibility and do not imply rooftop accuracy.
Census Public_AR_Current and live pages can change. Coordinates and returned identifying fields are frozen here as observed on the research date.
NCES school coordinates are from the returned 2024–2025 survey record, checked against the school's current official address; they are not claimed to be new 2026 measurements.
Team 1720 uses a town representative point and therefore remains a town-based screening result.
Teams 3777 and 6556 are within about 1–1.4 miles of the boundary. A change of downtown origin or of reference facility can affect borderline membership.
The spherical haversine calculation is an approximation to an ellipsoidal Earth model. Display distances are rounded to one decimal mile; classification uses the unrounded result.

Campus/host coordinates, town screening, and roster affiliation are different evidence layers. A school-address source alone does not establish a team-school affiliation; affiliation URLs are carried separately.
